title: Senior Technical Program Manager
description:
**Our Purpose**

*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200\+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*

**Title and Summary**


Senior Technical Program Manager
Job Description: Senior Specialist, Product Development, Digital Transformation \& Optimization  

  

Overview:  

Mastercard is a global technology company. Our mission is to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making payment and data transactions safe, simple, smart, and successful. Using secure data and networks, partnerships and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential. Our decency quotient, or DQ, drives our culture and everything we do inside and outside of our company. With connections across more than 210 countries and territories, we are building a sustainable world that unlocks priceless possibilities for all.  

  

The Digital Transformation and Optimization team is part of Core Solutions. We are responsible for optimizing eCommerce solutions and for driving transaction authorization improvement for digital transactions globally. We do this by being a consumer centric for our products and services and being relevant in all consumer money flows.
  

  

The Role:  

* Have good understanding of hybrid application integrations, analytical tools to measure and track customer experience, like Mixtiles, and Project management frameworks/ tools like GIT, copilot and Jira
* Responsible for identifying, analyzing, developing, and bringing solutions to market that meet customer needs through supporting stories, feature management and project planning, helping to make solid product decisions and deliver value
* Drive product evolution with a focus on data science, engineering and business impact by helping to maintain the product backlog, and prioritize requirements
* Provide Operational support of new products where authorization recommendations are delivered from an AI engine to an Mastercard global application
* Act as a Program Admin to support Mastercard product governance tools and services (Studio, Architecture Reviews, AI governance, Compliance and Data Security, etc.)
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams including engineering, data science, operations, and design to deliver scalable solutions that enhance product connectivity, data flow, and performance insight
* Continuously innovate and explore new approaches, tools, techniques, and technologies to solve business problems
* Stay updated on emerging trends in integration technologies (e.g., AI ML model \& and data analytics platforms (e.g., Thoughtspot, Power BI)

  

Candidates based in India only  

  

ALL ABOUT YOU  

The candidate should demonstrate:  

* Must have a minimum of 5 years of experience in technical product management and project management
* Passion for all things digital and intrinsic curiosity to understand new technology like Artificial Intelligence, Cloud solutions
* Entrepreneurial spirit and global mindset with a passion for learning and using data to solve large scale business problems
* Experience using project management tools like Git, Jira, Aha, etc is preferable
* Excellent communication \& influencing skills to work with internal and external stakeholders; ability to articulate problem statements, opportunity areas and complex data models
* Excellent project management and execution skills, with strong problem solving, highly analytical, quantitative communication and organizational skills
* Create and maintain material in support of product development and management: business cases, product roadmaps, success metrics, etc.
* Good to have experience with Enterprise Business Intelligence Platform/Data platforms
* Ability to articulate the business value of products and actively participate in sales enablement efforts
* Proven success in interacting with stakeholders to understand technical needs and ensure analyses and solutions effectively meet their requirements

**Corporate Security Responsibility**

  

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Project Manager
description:
Project Manager – Interior Design \& Architecture

**Company:** Avenir Design Studio  
**Location:** Mayapuri, New Delhi  
**Experience:** 1–3 Years  
**Qualification:** B.Arch / Diploma or Degree in Interior Designing / Architecture

Job Description

Avenir Design Studio is looking for a **Project Manager** with a background in **Interior Designing or Architecture** to manage and coordinate interior design and architectural projects from planning to execution.

Key Responsibilities

* Plan, coordinate, and monitor projects from start to completion.
* Coordinate with clients, architects, interior designers, vendors, contractors, and internal teams.
* Prepare and maintain project schedules, timelines, and progress reports.
* Ensure project deliverables are completed within the agreed timeline and quality standards.
* Coordinate drawings, designs, BOQs, material requirements, and project\-related documentation.
* Follow up with vendors, contractors, and team members for timely execution.
* Conduct regular project follow\-ups and identify potential delays or issues.
* Maintain proper records of project updates, revisions, and client requirements.
* Ensure effective communication between all stakeholders throughout the project.

Requirements

* Qualification in **Interior Designing, Architecture, or a related field**.
* **1–3 years of relevant experience** in project coordination/management.
* Good knowledge of interior design and architectural processes.
* Strong coordination, communication, and organizational skills.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks and projects simultaneously.
* Proficiency in MS Office/Excel; knowledge of AutoCAD or other design software will be an advantage.
* Good command of English and professional communication skills.

Perks \& Benefits

* **2nd \& 4th Saturday Off**
* Sunday Off
* Professional and growth\-oriented work environment
* Opportunity to work on diverse interior and architectural projects
* Career growth opportunities

**Job Location:** Mayapuri, New Delhi  
**Experience:** 1–3 Years  
**Employment Type:** Full\-time

Pay: ₹25,000\.00 \- ₹50,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Project Manager
description:
Process Transition \& Transformation

* **Lead end\-to\-end transition planning and delivery across business, network operations, and shared services.**
* Responsible for transition framework on cut\-over, rollback, parallel\-run, and stabilisation plans.
* **Manage BPO transitions, including knowledge transfer, SOPs, and steady\-state handover.**
* Drive process to improves efficiency, cycle time, and cost.
* **Oversee CRM, billing, ERP, and network\-tool transitions with IT, vendors, and business owners.**
* Project Delivery \& Ownership: \- Take full end\-to\-end ownership of project delivery from initiation to closure, ensuring all project milestones, deadlines, and quality standards are met within scope and budget.
* **Lead project planning sessions, define project schedules, and create comprehensive project plans that effectively track progress and manage dependencies.**
* Proactively identify and mitigate potential risks and issues, escalating as needed and implementing effective contingency plans.
* **Serve as the primary point of contact for all project\-related communications, providing regular updates on project status, risks, and performance metrics to key stakeholders.**
* Provide strong technical management and oversight for the development and delivery of innovative automation solutions.
* **Manage resource allocation and workload to ensure optimal team productivity and project success.**  Establish and maintain strong, collaborative relationships with all stakeholders, including clients, internal technical teams, and senior leadership.
* **Facilitate effective communication channels to ensure transparency and alignment on project goals and progress.**
* **Project Planning \& Delivery**
* Develop project plans covering scope, schedule, resources, budget, risks, and quality. **Manage budgets, track spend, and report variances.**  Maintain RAID logs with clear mitigation actions. **Run sprint and phase\-gate reviews to confirm readiness. Stakeholder \& Change Management**  Serve as primary contact for CXO stakeholders, senior leaders, governance forums, and cross\-functional teams including Network, IT, OSS/BSS, Finance, HR, Legal, and Commercial.
* **Implement change plans covering communication, training, and adoption tracking, while aligning all internal and external stakeholders to ensure smooth execution.**  Run steering committees, reviews, and executive updates with dashboards, and define RACI frameworks to drive clear accountability across business, vendor, and regulatory stakeholders.
* **Coordinate with OEM/SI vendors, offshore teams, and partners on quality and SLA delivery, managing expectations and supporting pre\-sales on transition costs, timelines, and delivery assurance. Performance Monitoring \& Reporting**  Define and track KPIs, OKRs, and success metrics for each transition milestone and steadystate phase.
* **Build and maintain real\-time project dashboards (JIRA, MS Project, Power BI, or equivalent) for portfolio\-level visibility.**  Conduct post\-transition reviews and lessons\-learned workshops; implement findings into the PMO knowledge base.
* **Ensure compliance with audit, regulatory, and data\-governance requirements throughout the project lifecycle.**
* **Qualifications \& Requirements**
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Electronics / Telecom / IT), Computer Science, or a related discipline.
* **10–12 years of progressive experience in project management, with a minimum of 5 years in a telecom environment.**
* Demonstrable experience managing process transition, service migration, or business transformation projects.
* **Strong command of project management tools**  Excellent communication, presentation, and executive\-stakeholder management skills.
* **Preferred qualification \- PMP (PMI), PRINCE2 Practitioner, or MSP certification.**  Exposure to cloud migration, network rollout, or digital transformation programmes in a telecom context.

description:

ABOUT CASA EXOTIQUE

Casa Exotique is a luxury architecture, interior design \& design\-build studio creating bespoke residential, hospitality and commercial spaces.

We are looking for a **Senior Architect** with strong technical and project\-management skills to work closely with the Founder and drive projects from **Design → BOQ → Procurement → Execution → Quality Control**.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

* Project planning, coordination and execution
* Coordinate Design, BOQ, Procurement, Vendors \& Site teams
* Prepare, review and validate **BOQs \& quantity take\-offs**
* Coordinate architectural, interior, MEP and vendor/shop drawings
* Ensure drawing accuracy, revisions, specifications and technical QA/QC
* Conduct site visits and monitor execution, quality and workmanship
* Identify technical issues, risks, delays and potential rework
* Coordinate contractors, vendors and procurement requirements
* Track project deliverables, issues and closures
* Prepare concise project updates and actionable reports for the Founder

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

**Qualification:** B.Arch / B.E. Civil; MBA in Construction/Project Management preferred.

**Experience:** 4–5 years in architecture/interiors, construction management, site execution, BOQ, drawing coordination and project management.

Experience in **luxury residential, hospitality, high\-end commercial or design\-build projects** is preferred.

MANDATORY SKILLS

**AutoCAD \| MS Excel \| BOQ \& Quantity Take\-offs \| Construction Drawings \| Architectural Detailing \| Site Execution \| Drawing Coordination \| Quality Control**

**Good to have:** Revit, MEP Coordination, Project Management Software, Cost Estimation, ERP/MIS.

THE IDEAL CANDIDATE

Someone who is **detail\-oriented, proactive and hands\-on**, comfortable with drawings, Excel, BOQs, construction sites, contractors and management—and capable of identifying problems **and proposing solutions**.

**Join Casa Exotique and take ownership of delivering high\-end projects from concept to completion.**
